decision.exact_command_or_message: Agent description "[case:debug] 15-bx SETUP-FAIL unblock plan", subagent_type general-purpose, prompt: "Write the unblock plan for SETUP-FAIL 15-bx (lane 5090-i3). The failure is: no reply of Cind within 150s in P1; read C:/KenshiTestRuns/imm26-5090-hx/15-bx/P1/reply.txt and the 15-bx row files. Write the plan as a file, then assign it with powershell -NoProfile -File C:/KenshiModding/tools/automation/setupfail.ps1 assign 15-bx <agent> <plan_path>. Do not edit the lane operator's rows and do not touch other lanes."
